title: Lazar sees flying saucer in S4 hangar

tellings.quote: I went into the hangar door and in the hangar door was the disc, the flying saucer. This is technology that doesn't even exist.

plain: In 1988 or 1989, at a hidden facility called S4 near Area 51, the secret Air Force test site in the Nevada desert, Bob Lazar says he walked up to a hangar door and saw a flying saucer inside. Lazar, who says he was hired to work there, tells it firsthand: "in the hangar door was the disc, the flying saucer. This is technology that doesn't even exist." If true, the US government had a craft of unknown origin in its hands.
